integrity: The full proof and standalone exact finite cross-checks are contained in the package; no claim of external certification or independent mathematical audit.
scientific_limitations: The exact law assumes i.i.d. atomless edge weights and independent identically distributed refresh samples; all cycles must be edge-disjoint. General graphs with overlapping cycles, correlated weights and metric scaling are outside scope. Novelty comparisons may be incomplete.
title: Sharp noise-stability ordering and Poisson refresh transition for cactus minimum spanning trees
